notes.title: Update 1.0.05 Released - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update 1.0.05 is officially out.  Below are the included changes.

-Camera Shake Normal/Low/Off added to Video Options for those with motion sickness
-Added a fix to help prevent infinite block bug 
-Added support for the following languages: Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Hungarian, Swedish.
